title: Fallout 3 — Per-Lounger Backend Shard / Resident Storage / Carrier Binding Audit v2.0

supersedes_unmerged_experiment.reason: The old v1.7 branch over-weighted Lounger #23 physical proximity after v1.8 established that Dad monitor status/stress NOTE assets are static and not memory persistence evidence.

question: Can the shipped Vault 112 asset graph bind James's exact Lounger #23 endpoint to a repeating per-lounger processing shard and then to a resident/session-specific backend state or memory-carrier association?

james_monitor.role: James-specific physical endpoint marker; not a dynamic memory store

export_design.official_master_admission: Exactly Fallout3.esm, Anchorage.esm, ThePitt.esm, BrokenSteel.esm, PointLookout.esm and Zeta.esm; non-official plugins block export.
graph_fields: reverse references to placed hardware and base records
semantic record candidates for Think Machine/resident/memory/persistence/carrier terms

spatial_reconstruction.phase_1: Rank Visiontron placements by 3D distance from the exact James monitor placement. The nearest is only GEOMETRIC_JAMES_VISIONTRON_CANDIDATE.
spatial_reconstruction.phase_2: For every Visiontron in Vault112a, rank terminal/computer-like placed refs by 3D distance.
spatial_reconstruction.phase_3: Count whether the same computer base repeatedly appears as the nearest local hardware around multiple Visiontrons.
spatial_reconstruction.phase_4: If James's candidate uses that repeated base, classify REPEATED_LAYOUT_SHARD_CANDIDATE, not functional proof.
spatial_reconstruction.reason: This tests the v1.9 central-coordinator plus per-lounger-shard model using shipped spatial assets rather than assuming a hidden one-chip-per-lounger design.

james_anchor_set: geometric James Visiontron candidate placed ref/base
James per-lounger shard layout candidate placed ref/base
reference_graph_reconstruction.direct_link_gate: Linked FormID from a James anchor is a DIRECT_JAMES_BACKEND_LINK_CANDIDATE only.
reference_graph_reconstruction.reverse_intersection_gate: A record that reverse-references a James anchor and independently contains backend/resident semantics becomes SOURCE_BOUND_BACKEND_STATE_CANDIDATE.
reference_graph_reconstruction.high_priority_gate: A source-bound candidate that also contains memory/persistence/storage/carrier semantics becomes HIGH_PRIORITY_MEMORY_PERSISTENCE_CANDIDATE.
reference_graph_reconstruction.promotion_requirement: Manual primary-record semantics must establish resident/session ownership, persistence direction or carrier association before PASS.

admission_ladder.meaning: James monitor has a unique/nearest Visiontron candidate
same local computer base repeats around multiple Visiontrons and the James candidate participates
linked/reverse-reference graph connects James monitor/Visiontron/shard to a backend or resident-state record
primary semantics bind that backend state specifically to James/session and demonstrate persistence or addressable resident memory
James-specific persisted state is directionally associated with the removable memory-carrier class compatible with Pinkerton import

save_james_effect.promotion_condition: Primary ESM semantics must bind the James-associated backend shard/session handle to persisted/addressable memory state; carrier association is a subsequent stronger edge.

next_gate.name: REAL_ESM_PER_LOUNGER_SHARD_REFERENCE_GRAPH_RECEIPT_v2.0

Manually review every source-bound/high-priority candidate before promotion.
